# Feature: Meshy avatar generating full-bleed atmosphere

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-18 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
While Meshy avatar generation is busy, the character-editor preview shows only a lightweight full-bleed ChatGPT-style loading atmosphere (CSS, no particle canvas). The initials fallback (“CH”) must not be visible. The effect must not freeze the editor.

## Preconditions
- Character Editor open; avatar source Meshy; job status queued/generating/rigging.
- Preview container is the sticky 4:5 card.

## Happy Path
- [ ] During busy job, preview area shows `data-avatar-meshy-generating="true"` covering the full 4:5 surface.
- [ ] No `data-avatar-surface-fallback` (initials) is visible while busy.
- [ ] Overlay is opaque; status label, progress %, and poll health remain readable.
- [ ] Animation uses CSS transform/opacity only (no canvas particle loop, no `shadowBlur`).
- [ ] When job leaves busy, overlay unmounts and `AvatarSurfaceViewer` returns (portrait/3D/fallback as before).

## Edge Cases
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` → static atmosphere, no swoosh loop.
- [ ] Progress/health markers (`data-avatar-meshy-generating-progress`, `data-avatar-meshy-health`) unchanged for e2e.
- [ ] Offline/waiting health tones still visible on the full-bleed overlay.

## Regression
- [ ] Idle / success preview still uses `AvatarSurfaceViewer` (portrait, WebGL, or initials fallback when no model).
- [ ] Meshy panel start/poll/confirm unchanged.
- [ ] `avatar-meshy-generation-check` still passes.

## Assumptions
- Replacing the viewer with the overlay while busy is preferred over stacking (avoids WebGL + CH under a semi-transparent layer).
- Visual reference is the ChatGPT-style blue mist/swoosh; implemented as CSS for performance next to the editor.
